reviews.author: Mount Calvary Baptist Church
reviews.text: Had part of a neighbor's tree fall on the corner of my house this morning at 7 am. I called Rodney's though I had never done business with him before. He and his crew were at my house by a little after 10 (they don't open until 9) and they had taken care of everything before noon. They did a fantastic job, cleaning up all the limbs and debris all for a reasonable price. I highly recommend them to you if you're in need of a tree service! ~Pastor Bob Benson

reviews.author: LaTonya A
reviews.text: We had a few trees super close to our home and the neighbor's so naturally concerned about who to trust removing them. With Mr Rodney's years of experience and a neighbor's referral we took a chance. Him and his crew did an amazing job. In addition, Mr. Rodney and his wife Ms Phyllis are super kind and understanding people. They understood the deadline I needed to make so very accommodating. With their reasonable prices I then hired them for a much bigger job. They did not disappoint. We are now able to enjoy more of our property.

reviews.author: Charlie Pearce
reviews.text: Highly recommend Rodney’s Tree Service Clayton NC. Mr Rodney, his wife and employees were outstanding helping us a remove large Oak Tree that was too close to our fence. They were honest, prompt and were competently professional! Couldn’t ask for a better job. They expertly downed the tree, ground up the stump and cleaned up to where you cannot even see where the original tree stood. They are a Godsend. If you ever need this kind of help, please give Rodney’s Tree Service a call !

reviews.author: Bobby Gardner
reviews.text: I have used Rodney's Tree Service several times to have trees and stumps removed at my home. They have always done a great job, were professional in interacting with me and provided a great price for their services. I would recommend Rodney, Phyliss and their team if you are looking to have trees or stumps removed from your property.

reviews.author: Justin Fyle
reviews.text: Rodney and his team are top notch! He arrived on time and provided a great price on the spot and completed the job in a timely manner. They removed 65+ trees and hauled everything away in a day and a half. Rodney was also on site the entire time and always had everything under control. I never had the first concern throughout the entire process. He also took the extra time to clean up and even brought in some extra screen top soil/dirt to fill some low spots in my yard without me even asking! Rodney is a very down to earth and genuine man. He also brought to my attention a neighbors oak tree that is massive (6’-7’ base) and posing a risk to our house as its hollow in the middle and we would have never noticed. (His team is also assisting with this issue) My experience with Rodney’s Tree Service was amazing and I will definitely be using them again soon for some other trees on my lot and referring them to anyone I can! Job well done!

reviews.author: Terry Lee
reviews.text: Mr.Rodney is a guy who knows what he is doing,if he tells you that a little limb won't even hit your roof believe him,his climbing guy is very skilled also,he cut a tree over a hundred years old hanging over the house,he said he could do it without anything touching the roof and he did,also went across the street got 4 of my neighbors trees hanging over his house,he was very impressed after watching him cut mine.Do yourself a favor and Rodney he will appreciate it and you will be glad you did.

reviews.author: William
reviews.text: Great service! Rodney was knowledgeable and great to work with. After we received a quote to remove an existing tree, a storm brought down additional trees on our property. Phyllis and Rodney got us scheduled right away to take care of the mess, and their prices were very fair. Rodney takes pride in his work, and it shows. He did his best to keep lawn damage to a minimum, which is to be expected with this kind of job and greatly appreciated. Where we had trees removed, you can’t even tell they were ever there! He mentioned that several times during the project, and he was absolutely right. The ground is level with no dips where the trees used to be. We will definitely use them again in the future and highly recommend their services!

reviews.author: Dale Spencer
reviews.text: Highly recommend Rodney's Tree Service. Rodney did work for one of our neighbors and the job looked great. I needed several bushes removed as well as a tree stump. My neighbor gave me Rodney's phone number. I talked with Phyllis to set up an appointment. I was very pleased with work done. The price was several hundred dollars less than other estimates. I will definitely use their service again in the future

reviews.author: richard pope
reviews.text: Came home one Friday after working out of town to find a dead tree had fallen over from a storm. Got in touch with Phyllis and Rodney came over next day. Rodney performed great work and did an excellent job with clean up. He even took down another tree that was dead that was possibly going to come down soon. Very pleased with the work and grateful of the quickness of coming out. Will have to get a few more trees taken down and will definitely use Rodney again. My last photo was taken before Rodney had finished.

reviews.author: Anthony Shell
reviews.text: ST Wooten was contracted to construct a round-about at Cornwallis and Josephine. They installed a silt fence a couple of feet from the tree line were I live. When they clear brush for the easement there, they cut the roots of the Cypress trees lining my property. Over time, the trees started falling because the roots had died. I spent months dealing with ST Wooten and Right-of-Way trying to get them to clear the trees off my property. Because the trees been down for months, I had multiple tree services stopping by to give me quotes. All them were a bit to pricey. I found Rodney's Tree Sercice online and gave him a call. The first time his crew came was back in October 2024 to remove four fallen trees and to cut down two leaning trees. His quote was far more reasonable than the others. The second time his team came was 01/01/2026 to remove two fallen trees, grind some tree stumps, and to cut down one leaning tree. His team did a great job removing the all of the fallen debris from my property and not messing up my yard. I enjoyed how he took the time talk to me as a human being and not as just another paycheck. I would highly recommend his services anyone that has trees issues on their property.

reviews.author: Sandra Currie
reviews.text: What a great job these guys did with our pine and our tree out back! Rodney knows what he is doing. He went above and beyond. We will be using them again. If you need Tree removal and stump grinding! Rodney’s Tree Service is the place to call.

reviews.author: Markus Delello
reviews.text: Rodney and Phyllis are great people that do great work at an honest and fair price, that can be tough to find these days. I had three trees removed in precarious spots that could have easily caused damage to my house or property. Their precision is why I will use them to remove more compromised trees on my property.

reviews.author: Sam Nagel
reviews.text: Fantastic company! Great experience, quality, and service for an unbeatable price. I recommend 100% to use them, I had 3 very large trees removed, stumps ground, and everything cleaned and removed in a day!! No hesitation to use them again.

reviews.author: Patty Sopko
reviews.text: I don’t know if my first review went out. The owners are fabulous. The workers were skilled and thorough. I think they could charge a little more (sorry future clients). Highly recommend. Hire quickly. There is a little wait time but worth it.

reviews.author: Sean Hoolan
reviews.text: Rodney and the crew our the best. I have used them for multiple jobs over the years. The yard is amazingly clean and level. GREAT MAN and great company

reviews.author: Mike Bullock
reviews.text: Rodney and his crew were a real pleasure to work with, price was great and the work done was second to none if you need any tree work done don’t hesitate to call Rodney you won’t be disappointed!!!!!

reviews.author: steve zeller
reviews.text: We had a tree that was leaning toward the house quite a bit. I contacted 6 tree services around my home and only 3 got back to me. The one that was most professional, reassuring, and offered the best price was Rodney’s Tree Service. They took the time to provide an in person estimate and worked with me to provide the best scheduling for the removal. Mr Rodney is a gentleman and is true to his southern roots. Our tree was remove without a hitch, on time and there was no hidden fees. Clean up and haul away was perfect. Give them call you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Glen & Amber Spencer
reviews.text: We love Rodney’s Tree service, and their team. From the start of communication, to scheduling an estimate, on time to day of service…and was shocked at how fast and efficient the job was done. We will be using them for future Tree service needs!

reviews.author: William Wehunt
reviews.text: Rodney did exactly what we asked for a very reasonable price. He offered advice on planting new trees. He did as little damage to my yard as could be expected. I would certainly use them again.

reviews.author: Cathy Grant
reviews.text: Rodney's tree service was recommended to us by our neighbor. We came home from our vacation this past week only to find a large limb of a tree laid over on our roof. We called, spoke to Phyllis ,who was very personable and nice. Rodney came out, gave us an estimate on Wednesday, and Thursday he and his 2 helpers came with his equipment. , approx 4 hours later Rodney had our tree down & limbs and debris removed. Thank you all for such a quick response in our dilemma!

reviews.author: Gahlon James
reviews.text: I've used Rodney's Tree Service twice in the past, first to take down three trees that were dying, and then to trim a couple of Bradford Pear trees. Both times the service provided was above and beyond. Rodney is so experienced, he definitely knows his stuff. Lately, I needed some pine branches cut. Rodney came over and noticed a pine tree that was dying from Pine Beetle infestation. He and his crew came over at 4:30 PM, removed the tree, trimmed the branches from the other trees, ground the stump, cleaned up the area, and hauled away the tree, all by 8:30 PM. Wonderful job, you can't tell there was ever a 70-year old pine tree there. Need tree service? Definitely call Rodney.

reviews.author: Grady Willard
reviews.text: We had a dead tree and some others the tops had fallen out. Called and spoke to Phyliss about getting an estimate. Rodney came out on a Friday, looked at our trees, gave estimate in a timely manner. Very professional, knowledgeable, and friendly. Scheduled a day for removal, did a great job cutting and cleaning up. Rodney also noticed the end of our drive had a rut the rain had washed out and he was nice enough to level it out before loading his machine back on the trailer. Very pleased with the work. Will definitely use again.

reviews.author: Lydia
reviews.text: We contacted Rodney's tree service based off of reviews. Overall, the job of cutting trees down was done well, and I would recommend this company. There's just a few things to be cautious of with the service because, as many do, the contract states they do not take responsibility for any damage done on the lawn. (HOWEVER, in my case they did come back to fix the issues from out of contract activity and completed the work.) .If it's raining or bad weather, reschedule as the property is more susceptible to damage. .Do not let a truck or any other vehicle besides the skid steer on your lawn (unless you agree and do not mind the damage it may cause). .Make sure they only do what's contracted (ex. if cutting, not pull up a stump creating a hole). For all involved it's better to follow the contract, so make sure to ask detailed questions about exactly how the work will be carried out, and do not change anything in the plan agreed upon. I would not suggest handing over full payment until the job is completed. If it's in your contract to pay up front, ask to change it to half up front, half when done before approving the contract. If you're not fully agreed on the contract and payment, you may wish to look for other quotes. *Overall, the company will provide you with a completed project as requested. And Phyllis is an absolute gem, her customer service is fantastic!

reviews.author: Clint Shedrick
reviews.text: Once again Rodney's Tree Service to the rescue! I have used Rodney's Tree Service on two prior occasions so didnt hesitate to reach out to them when i needed some more trees removed. As expected, the were very prompt with scheduling a quote and were ready to start on the spot. I enjoy not only the professionalism of their work, but also the talks with Rodney and Phyllis. I highly recommend Rodney's Tree Service!

reviews.author: Steve Grimes
reviews.text: I called Rodney's Tree Service to see about getting an estimate. He came to our house almost immediately. He did a lot of tree work and most impressive was the fact that he didn't really make a mess in the yard. He did a lot of work and it only took one day. The price was great.

reviews.author: Steve Miller
reviews.text: Rodney is a true professional; great work on a bunch of really difficult trees, great clean up. Show up when they say they will and go above and beyond; highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rebecca Gurney
reviews.text: Love the work Rodney and his team did for us. We recently removed 2 Bradford Pear trees from our front yard and Rodney made sure the job was done right and even had some good suggestions on ways to improve the other trees on our property. They were quick to get scheduled and had a fair price, we'll definitely be using them again for our next big yard project.

reviews.author: S McCutch
reviews.text: I have used Rodney's Tree service twice in the last few years and am very happy with the service they provide. Fast turnaround times on estimates, and great customer service! They took out two large River Birch trees next to my driveway recently and they ground the stumps, regraded the slope and ditch next to my driveway, and cleaned up all the debris . You would never know that the trees used to be there. These folks know what they are doing! I highly recommend their service.

reviews.author: Thomas Todaro
reviews.text: Very professional and excellent work performed by Rodney's Tree Service. Rodney and his crew cut down 2 huge trees that were close to our house. We are very pleased with Rodney and his team and will definitely call on him again if needed.

reviews.author: Eula Barnes
reviews.text: Rodney and his crew did a fantastic job of cutting and removing a tree for me. They didn't waste any time getting the job done, I highly recommend if you need a tree removed. Thanks Rodney.

reviews.author: Craig Shelley
reviews.text: If anyone is looking for tree service I highly recommend Rodney’s Tree service. They did great work and in a timely fashion. I had a question about the work they did and the work was fixed right on the spot. Rodney the owner is onsite while the work is done. He made sure I was happy with all the work they did.

reviews.author: Robert Gettings
reviews.text: We used Rodney's Tree Service a year ago and again several months ago. Both times we were very happy with the service. He was able to take down a large oak tree in front of our house that we didn't realize was dying and posed a danger from high winds. He and his wife, Phyllis are good folks who are reliable and fair. We will call them again when we need more tree work.

reviews.author: Jeffrey leshinsky
reviews.text: This is the second time I’ve used Rodney’s Tree Service. Rodney and his crew did a fantastic job removing a couple trees and grinding some stumps in my yard. Aside from the tree service they performed, Rodney took great care to make sure his equipment wouldn’t damage my driveway. He and his team leveled the area where they were working and even fixed a spot near the road where a truck (not one of Rodney’s crew) left some ruts in the grass. I wouldn’t hesitate to call on Rodney again for future tree removal. Great work, great crew, great company!

reviews.author: Rolf Grandstaff
reviews.text: Rodney's Tree Service did an outstanding job for us removing 3 large pine trees from our front yard. These trees were removed with a minimum of damage to our yard using precision cuts to drop them. The crew meticulously cleaned up the work area after they were done so much so that our yard looked cleaner after they finished with it than it had before they started removing the trees. The stumps were also ground down and the area raked/smoothed over to the point where you could hardly tell where the trees had been. All of this was done for a very fair price. In the office Phyllis always was available to quickly get back to us on any questions/concerns we might have. We'd highly recommend Rodney's for anyone looking to have trees/stumps removed from their yard.

reviews.author: Sharon Thibault
reviews.text: I had to have several large trees removed and several more trees pruned in the Fall of 2021. After meeting for the estimate, I felt Phyllis and Rodney were a solid choice for the work. They were prompt, reasonable, and professional. Rodney and his crew were respectful of my property as well as my neighbors’ properties, while working. If you are looking for an experienced, deeply knowledgeable and responsible logger for your job, I would recommend you contact Rodney and his team.

reviews.author: David
reviews.text: Excellent service to get a tree removed. The team were very quick and efficient. Admin was handled very well as well.

reviews.author: Michael Carroll
reviews.text: Rodney and his crew did an excellent job on taking down, and hauling off a very large dead tree next to my house.. They picked up everything, and left my yard spotless... I highly recommend Rodney's tree service !!!!

reviews.author: Cameron Tarrh
reviews.text: We had an excellent experience with Rodney's Tree Service having 2 large trees removed from our front yard. The crew worked swiftly and efficiently, and the end result was a smooth and clear yard that is seeded for grass to grow. Ms. Phyllis was exceptionally prompt at responding and professional as well as extremely personable. She even brought us flowers knowing we were expecting a baby soon. We also appreciated that they were able to come ahead of our scheduled date. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Melanie Hill
reviews.text: Rodney was on time, dependable, easy to communicate with, efficient, friendly and so much more. I would recommend him 100 times over, he is even coming back to do more work on my property. Absolute pleasure to work with both him and his wife, Phyllis, did exactly what we asked for and it turned out even better than we could have imagined.

reviews.author: jen moore
reviews.text: We had a very good experience with Rodney’s Tree Service. Communication was very quick and very responsive. We had an invoice same day and scheduled for removal within a few days of assessment. He did an excellent job with the tree removal. He was conscientious and careful in removal so as not to put ruts in the lawn or damage the surrounding area. Stump removal was very thorough. He put down topsoil and filled in/graded the area. His pricing beat competitors. He and his crew were very pleasant and professional. Highly recommend . Edited to add- I would encourage them to find a different soul to put down to fill in any deficit. The soil put down is like concrete and we can get anything (even winter rye) to grow. We are still pleased with his service and would recommend but I would advise different soil to be put down

reviews.author: Kelly S
reviews.text: Rodney's Tree Service was easy to work with. They provided a quote within a few days. We had three trees removed. They did an excellent job and were very meticulous with cleaning up the area afterward. We appreciate their professionalism and will definitely use them in the future.

reviews.author: harry mcnutt
reviews.text: Rodney is the best in the business. Had him come remove some trees from a new build. They were able to schedule around my needs and concerns as I had SOD freshly laid. Once on the job his crew and him took special care to ensure they did not tear up my new lawn. After they were complete, you could hardly tell there was any heavy equipment on my grass. They did a outstanding job and I would recommend to anyone in need of tree removal.

reviews.author: Susan Beck
reviews.text: Rodney's Tree Service was awesome! They were on time, very professional, and did excellent quality work in a short amount of time! And Rodney is a great guy that cares deeply about pleasing his customers! We would absolutely use them again and will refer them to anyone that needs tree removal!

reviews.author: Rachel C.
reviews.text: Rodney and Phyllis were both very responsive. It was so nice to have a person actually answer the phone and speak with me about what I needed. The communication was excellent. As far as the work went, Rodney did a great job. He showed up on time and completed the tree removal quickly. I would highly recommend this company to anyone looking to have trees removed from their property.

reviews.author: Brian Cullins
reviews.text: Rodney and his crew did a great job with very large and dangerous trees on my property. Rodney is an experienced professional and I highly recommend his tree cutting service. I don’t think there is a job he can not handle.

reviews.author: Anthony Wyatt
reviews.text: Needed several large pine trees that were pretty close to both my house and my neighbor’s house removed. Rodney’s Tree Service was able to meet with me and my neighbor in person and provided a next day written work estimate. The tree work was scheduled within the next week. The team arrived as scheduled and professionally cut and removed the pines and cleaned site on same day. Thank you for the quality tree work.

reviews.author: Jeff Lesh
reviews.text: Rodney and his team were amazing. They showed up and Rodney clearly laid out the plan for the day. His crew worked hard and it was a wet rainy day. Rodney identified a few more at risk trees and sure enough they were infested with worms. Rodney cleared all the junk trees away and left the couple of Oak trees, his team also cut the Oak trees into manageable chunks to move around the yard easier. I would not hesitate to hire Rodney again, I highly recommend Rodney's Tree Service.

reviews.author: Jennifer Hawley
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company, they are a reliable, honest, hardworking company and did an absolutely fantastic job. We had a handful of tress we wanted cut over our driveway and knew we need more cut because of disease. Rodney was very honest and walked our property and let us know what needed to come down for the safety of our house. His prices were so reasonable we went ahead and let him cut all of trees that he recommended because because of disease. All of the work was done in a very timely manner and left our property better then when the came. If you need tress cut use this company!!!

reviews.author: Tammy Casterlin
reviews.text: I would not hesitate to recommend Rodney's Tree Service to anyone needing tree removal. We had five large trees near the house that needed to come down, and I was impressed by the entire team's professionalism and the care they took to clean up afterward, all at a very competitive price. We will definitely hire this company in the future!

reviews.author: Kendal Moore
reviews.text: We needed to have over a half dozen trees removed from our property. I came across glowing reviews for Rodney's Tree Service on a neighborhood FB page. Rodney came out not long after I contacted him, surveyed the trees in question, listened closely to our concerns and inspected the trees we wanted removed. Shortly after he left, we received his estimate, which was pretty much what we thought it would be given the number of trees, and their relative sizes and location in the yard. After we quickly accepted, Rodney and his crew came back out that same afternoon and efficiently took the trees down, removed all the debris, leaving not a scratch in the yard. He and his crew (especially Phyllis in the office) were courteous, respectful, professional and quite knowledgeable about the work. Rodney also gave us suggestions regarding a couple of trees which might become problems at some point. When that time comes, we will definitely be giving him calling to assist us once more with our troublesome trees.

reviews.author: Joan Custer
reviews.text: We had a HUGE pin oak tree in close proximity to our house AND a medium/large red oak tree on our property line. Our neighbor wanted the wood for fire wood. Rodney and crew methodically cut down the first tree and placed the wood in neat piles in my neighbor's back yard. Then when second huge tree was down, they again painstakingly stacked the wood and cut it in manageable lengths. To me this was above and beyond the call of duty. I couldn't fathom how they were going to get the HUGE tree down but down it came precisely where Rodney said it would. They left the area all cleaned up and were very conscious of keeping our property undamaged by any of the heavy equipment he used. He knows what he's doing and his crew was a joy to work with. I highly recommend him and will confidently use his services again if necessary. Sincerely, Steve Custer

reviews.author: Hunter Ellis
reviews.text: Rodney, Phyllis, and team were very responsive and professional during our transaction. We had a tricky tree removal but they removed the tree with little difficulty and did a decent job on clean up. We had a month long wait from quote to service but was worth wait with quality and assurances received. They are insured and able to provide evidence of coverage, which was an important deciding factor for me with my difficult removal scenario.

reviews.author: Tracy Hackal
reviews.text: If your looking for old fashioned great service, Rodney's Tree Service is it! It is SO hard to find service like this these days. Someone actually answered the phone, listened to me, and responded with a solution the SAME day. Their pricing is fair and these are honest people. I had a huge down limb from an oak tree in my backyard; they gave me quote and provided the clean up /service the same day I called. Talk about quick! I would definitely use them again. If you need a tree removed, this is the company you want!

reviews.author: Shelly Sadler
reviews.text: I had 6 stumps and a 60 foot tree removed from my back yard and I'm extremely pleased with the service Rodney's Tree Service provided. They gave me a very reasonable estimate and scheduled the service within one week. Not only did they come early, they removed everything the same day. They filled the stump holes with top soil and evened the ground out where everything was removed. I couldn't be happier. I am a repeat customer and I will only use them for any future tree needs. I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Mark Parker
reviews.text: This past week we used Rodney for the second time. We had been so pleased with his work several years ago. He removed a couple of trees and stumps for us, and while on site we inquired about a couple of others that were of concern. He dealt with those also. He and his team went above and beyond what we had asked for or expected and left our property in better shape than before. He is an honest man who knows trees and safety.

reviews.author: Jeff Vincent
reviews.text: Very pleased with the experience. I had to have an 85' pine tree removed from between two houses and also a dead tree. Rodney's showed up on time to give both the estimate as well as perform the work. They were all really nice to deal with and did a great job. Highly recommended!! Thanks,

reviews.author: Brian Money
reviews.text: We highly recommend Rodney's Tree Service for any tree trimming or removal on your property. We had several trees removed and a 100+ year Oak tree trimmed. Extremely happy with the quality of work and timely service. Rodney and Phyllis are great to work with. We would call them again if needed.

reviews.author: John Trapasso
reviews.text: Rodney's Tree Service was selected out of 6 Bids and companies that we interviewed. Of the 6 only 5 bothered to show up and only 1 ever followed up with us and that was Rodney's Tree Service. Rodney was easy to talk to, honest and professional. He and his team removed 4 trees from our property and did a great job getting it completed in a timely manner.

reviews.author: Danny Chastain
reviews.text: He did a great a great job. Had a very large dead pine close to the house. When he came and looked at it for the first time he thought it could come down in a storm, so came out the next day, a Saturday to get it taken care of ASAP. He dropped it in a very narrow spot between trees perfectly.

reviews.author: Erik Mattingly
reviews.text: Rodney was very thorough and professional when he came out to estimate the job. He asked questions and made sure we both understood what I wanted done. His wife, Phyllis, provided great communications and promptly e-mailed a detailed quote for the job. They were very efficient performing the work and I was very pleased with the results.

reviews.author: Jenny Begnoche
reviews.text: Rodney’s Tree Service was excellent in removing a few trees and grinding multiple existing stumps from our property. They were professional and thorough, and we were very happy with their work. Would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Lisa Walton
reviews.text: Contacted them to have some tree stumps grinded down and some debris removed. They did an excellent job and were very fair in all costs. They gave me an estimate and scheduled a time to begin work. They stayed in contact with me over everything and I am very pleased with all they done.

reviews.author: Jodie Pond
reviews.text: I had a monster red oak removed. It sat directly between 2 homes. It was amazing to watch Rodneys team work on that tree. Limbs were cut and lowered safely right on target and the ground crew cut them up and got them out of the way for the next limb to come down. They cleaned up when finished and you wouldn't know a monster tree used to be there. The communication from beginning to end was clear and in writing. This company is professional, friendly and hard working. I highly recommend Rodneys Tree Service.

reviews.author: Tommie Webster
reviews.text: Absolute 5***** Rating Professionalism and quality of work. From the first phone call with Ms. Phyllis to the original meeting with Mr. Rodney to the day of service and tree work this team is top notch. Clear, concise and complete. A true mentor to the community and his customers. Thank you again for your quality of work and service and the attention to detail and utmost respect for my property.

reviews.author: Donnie Hawker
reviews.text: I have used Rodney’s Trees Service for several jobs at my house. He is a man of his word and will make sure you are happy when the work is done. His crew work efficiently and are very polite.

reviews.author: Christian Nilsen
reviews.text: Rodney is absolutely wonderful. He is very personable, professional and a keen attention to detail. After the trees were cut down, he cleaned up the area of all the debris. He also did all the work for a fair price.

reviews.author: Julia Kapke
reviews.text: We recently had a tree removed and some trees trimmed around our house. Rodney was very knowledgeable and professional during the consultation. The service was timely and the site was left neat and tidy. We were very pleased!

reviews.author: Mark Cooper
reviews.text: Rodney and crew did an awesome job - 7 mature oak (huge trees) close to house and carport. grated and yard looked great. Exceeded expectations - will use again - thank you Rodney.

reviews.author: Jeffrey Watson
reviews.text: We are a repeat customer of Rodney’s Tree Service. Once again we are thoroughly satisfied with the work accomplished. The entire team is very personable and professional. We would highly recommend the team to anyone! Thank you to Mrs. Phyllis Mr. Rodney & the team!!

reviews.author: Marilyn Trent
reviews.text: Very professional job. First crew came out and started the job. Second crew arrived and finished, including 100 foot poplar, stump removal and yard cleanup, all for a very reasonable price. Rodney even smoothed out my gravel driveway. I will definitely use their services in the future.

reviews.author: Lynn Brandon
reviews.text: Rodney and team remove one huge Pine and several smaller hardwoods as well as trimming others. Excellent to work with and quick response. Came same day I contacted to provide quote and did the work just a few days later. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Lisa Dillahunt
reviews.text: I would recommend Rodney’s Tree Service to anyone needing tree service. The crew did a great job! Mr. Rodney followed up the same day of service to make sure we were satisfied with the job.

reviews.author: karen earegood
reviews.text: Rodney and his team do great work. We had a Crepe Myrtle tree that needed to be removed. They show up on time and always clean up afterward.

reviews.author: Bob Paye
reviews.text: Had half dozen trees leaning towards my house with branches close to hitting it. Rodney safely and cleanly removed those and a dozen others to create a much needed safety zone. He understood my needs and did a great job at a FANTASTIC price. He's now my "go-to" professional for tree services.

reviews.author: Karen Strong
reviews.text: Rodney and his crew worked very hard and efficient at cutting two trees down, branch removal, three stump removal. The cleanup was very good. I will definitely call them back for tree pruning next year. thank you for the big job.

reviews.author: Larry Hall
reviews.text: Rodney and his team did a fantastic job removing trees from my property. The price was more than fair and they are very skilled. I highly recommend these guys!

reviews.author: Gladys Bender
reviews.text: Rodney's Tree Service always does great work. I have had them remove several trees and grind stumps. Very reasonably priced. Highly recommend Rodney's tree service.

reviews.author: Tee Smith
reviews.text: Rodney’s Tree Service has been a God send! I was giving the run around with other companies but he came out assured me the job could be done and effectively! Thank you again! Good price and great work!

reviews.author: Colleen Zanni
reviews.text: This is the 3rd time we have used Rodney's Tree Service. They always do a very good job removing trees and cleaning up. We will definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Linda Adams
reviews.text: I highly recommend Rodney's Tree Service. Rodney is one of the most knowledgeable people about trees, honest and hardworking. His crew is hardworking and very efficient. Pricing is good.

reviews.author: Carla Moore
reviews.text: We have used Rodney's Tree Service a few times and his crew did and always does a fantastic job removing a trees and grinding some stumps in our yard. We would recommend him!

reviews.author: Steven Collins
reviews.text: Rodney is honest and respectfully caring about each job. Quickly and professionally done. Cleaned up so well after the job you didn't even know they were there. I am a repeat customer and will continue to be as services are needed.

reviews.author: Debbie Holloman
reviews.text: I called Rony to rescue my cat from a tree! He was so responsive and was there within 2 hours! He knew exactly what to do and was very sweet with my pet. His fee was reasonable and he was highly skilled. Many Thanks Rony!

reviews.author: Darrell Weber
reviews.text: I have used Rodney's tree service several times in the last few years and would tell anyone that asked that when you need tree service Rodney is the man for the job. Not only does he do a great job his prices are very reasonable.

reviews.author: Philip Pillittere
reviews.text: Excellent service, reasonable price, goes above and beyond! Will absolutely recommend to any of our friends and family! Rodney and his team are all about character and integrity!!! We will be hiring them to make our dream backyard!

reviews.author: Kelly Siegert
reviews.text: We had 7 huge pine trees taken down from in front of our house. Communication was great before and during the process. We appreciated the good job tht they did, along with the fair price.

reviews.author: John Evans
reviews.text: Rodney's Tree Service does an excellent job of tree removal, stump grinding and cleanup. I have used them 3 times ! and have recommended them to friends and neighbors

reviews.author: Eric & Carrie Seaman
reviews.text: Mr Rodney..The man..the myth...the legend. Excellent work with attention to detail. Gets the job done and make sure he leaves no trace he was there...maybe a missing tree or shrub though. Great guy. Great crew.

reviews.author: Rebecca Flegler
reviews.text: They were able to come out and give a quote and get the job done for a fair price in just over a week. Made sure everything was done exactly how I needed it. Would 100% work with them again in the future.

reviews.author: Tom Hormby
reviews.text: The team did a good job for a difficult task. They removed three trees, three brush piles and a log pile while, avoiding any damage to fences, drain fields, lawns or other trees.

reviews.author: Rob Farrell
reviews.text: Service was professional and as you would expect. Free estimates. Phyllis was very nice in coordinating times that worked for me for service. Job site was left clean and without any debris when the job was done.

reviews.author: Sonya Clodfelter
reviews.text: Fast and effective service. Took my at least 50 foot tall tree down cut up loaded in about 3 hours or less.I didn’t know how big it was until It was down. Very good price

reviews.author: Dave Smith
reviews.text: Legitimately incredible experience, from our initial call until the crew pulled away after finishing the job. They were on-time, engaged, explained everything, and the work was performed quickly and thoroughly. They are absolute experts in the field, and I will certainly be a repeat customer.

reviews.author: Rich Stephenson
reviews.text: The team came and cut the treetop out that had been damaged during a storm. They were in and out in about an 1 hour, cleaned up all the limbs and no damage to the yard. I highly recommend and would definitely use again.

reviews.author: Clifton Helpingstine
reviews.text: Rodney and his team came out and did a wonderful job opening up our yard and taking out our huge pine and gum trees. I will be calling them again if there is ever a need for their services.

reviews.author: Curtis Smith
reviews.text: Good folks supplying good service. Value for money. A long day with several unexpected challenges, but job well done. Would use again!

reviews.author: Nick Dollar
reviews.text: It has been a blessing to work with Rodney’s tree service. We are repeat customers and will always be.

reviews.author: Diana Massa
reviews.text: Rodney’s took down large pines for us. Many inside our fenced area and/or close to our home. Excellent work, great communication and clean up.

reviews.author: Laurie D
reviews.text: Rodney did a great job in my yard. They cleaned up and hauled everything off and even killed a snake while they were there!

reviews.author: Carol Hildebrandt
reviews.text: Great people! Quick, efficient, and professional! Took care of us by removing a tree that could have destroyed our house...THANK YOU THANK YOU THANK YOU!!!! I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tim Hobbs
reviews.text: Rodney and his crew did a great job safely cutting down, removing several trees. They also cleaned up afterwards. Great guys

reviews.author: Lisa Daugherty
reviews.text: Fast, friendly service. Had 4 trees removed and stumps ground. Very careful not to cause any damage to surroundings.

reviews.author: Pam Blackwell
reviews.text: We would highly recommend Rodney. He did a fantastic job and definitely went beyond our expectations with his clean up.

reviews.author: Kevin West
reviews.text: What a wonderful company. They did a great job. Went beyond the requirements in helping ensure my safety cutting up the tree they felled.

reviews.author: Robert Pratash
reviews.text: Best company ever. They did everything they said they would do and more. Would highly recommend them to anyone

reviews.author: Richard Bruce
reviews.text: I didn't do any business but I received estimates which were very fair and the communication was excellent.

reviews.author: Sam Saunders
reviews.text: Super nice guy. Did as I asked, and was prompt. I would recommend to anyone to check all of his services and use him.

reviews.author: Cecilia Garama
reviews.text: Rodney and Phyllis were absolutely amazing. I can’t recommend this company enough! May God continue to bless the work of their hands. Great service, fair pricing. I’m not looking for another tree removal service! Nope! Rodney’s tree service all the way

reviews.author: Sherrie Parish
reviews.text: Rodney, Phyllis and team were phenomenal. Not only were they responsive, the work crew was amazing. They were efficient, completed the job timely, and cleaned up after the job well. We are grateful for such a great experience. Thanks to all of you!
